test_cases.input: My 4-month-old was feeding and suddenly stopped breathing. Her lips are turning blue and she isn't making any sound.
test_cases.rationale: Complete airway obstruction with cyanosis in infant = immediate resuscitation

test_cases.input: He ate a peanut snack and now his face and lips are swelling up and he's struggling to breathe.
test_cases.rationale: Facial swelling + respiratory distress after allergen = anaphylaxis

test_cases.input: She's had vomiting and diarrhea since yesterday, no wet nappy in over 12 hours, and she's floppy and too sleepy to cry.
test_cases.rationale: No urine 12h + lethargy + floppy = severe dehydration

test_cases.input: He has a high fever, keeps saying his neck hurts and won't bend it, and I see small purple spots on his legs that don't fade when I press them.
test_cases.rationale: Fever + neck stiffness + non-blanching rash = meningococcal disease

test_cases.input: My son had a fever and suddenly his whole body started shaking for about a minute. It stopped on its own and now he's tired but looking at me and responding.
test_cases.rationale: Post-ictal but alert febrile seizure = urgent assessment

test_cases.input: He pulled a pot of boiling water on himself. There's a large blistering area on his arm and chest.
test_cases.rationale: Large blistering scald burn = emergency

test_cases.input: She fell off her bike and hit her head. She was knocked out for a few seconds but now she's talking and knows who I am, just has a headache.
test_cases.rationale: Head injury with brief LOC = needs emergency evaluation

test_cases.input: I found my son with an open bottle of my sleeping pills and some are missing. He seems drowsier than usual.
test_cases.rationale: Unknown medication ingestion + altered consciousness = emergency

test_cases.input: She's diabetic and today she's been vomiting, breathing really fast, and her breath smells fruity.
test_cases.rationale: Kussmaul breathing + fruity breath + vomiting in diabetic = DKA

test_cases.input: His asthma is bad, he can barely say two words without stopping to breathe, and his lips look a bit blue.
test_cases.rationale: Severe asthma with cyanosis and inability to speak = life-threatening

test_cases.input: She has a barky cough and when she breathes in I can hear a loud noise even when she's just sitting still.
test_cases.rationale: Stridor at rest = significant airway narrowing

test_cases.input: Baby has a runny nose and a bit of a cough for two days, still feeding fine and no fever, just sounds congested.
test_cases.rationale: Mild URTI, feeding well, no distress

test_cases.input: My 2-month-old has a temperature of 38.2, otherwise seems okay, feeding a bit less than usual.
test_cases.rationale: Any fever under 3 months = sepsis workup, emergency

test_cases.input: He's thrown up twice today and had loose stools once, but he's still playing and drank some water fine.
test_cases.rationale: Mild gastro, well hydrated, active

test_cases.input: Just a runny nose and mild cough for a day, no fever, she's eating and playing normally.
test_cases.rationale: Common cold, self-care

test_cases.input: He's been drooling a lot and chewing on everything, a bit fussy but no fever.
test_cases.rationale: Normal teething

test_cases.input: I noticed a small patch of rash on her arm today, no fever, she doesn't seem bothered by it.
test_cases.rationale: Localized asymptomatic rash

test_cases.input: He hasn't pooped in 3 days but is eating fine and not in pain, just a bit uncomfortable.
test_cases.rationale: Mild constipation, no red flags

test_cases.input: She scraped her knee on the pavement, small graze with a bit of blood but she's already back to playing.
test_cases.rationale: Minor abrasion

test_cases.input: A mosquito bit him on the arm, it's a bit red and slightly swollen but he's not bothered.
test_cases.rationale: Localized insect bite, no systemic reaction

test_cases.input: She's been pulling at her ear and has a fever of 38.5, but is still eating and playing okay.
test_cases.rationale: Likely otitis media, otherwise well

test_cases.input: He says his throat hurts a bit, no trouble swallowing, still eating and drinking normally.
test_cases.rationale: Mild pharyngitis, no distress

test_cases.input: Her eye is a bit pink with some discharge this morning, no fever, doesn't bother her vision.
test_cases.rationale: Likely conjunctivitis

test_cases.input: He's vomited a few times today but has kept down some water and still has energy to play a little.
test_cases.rationale: Mild vomiting, no dehydration

test_cases.input: She's had loose stools for 5 days, no blood, still drinking and peeing normally, just tired of it.
test_cases.rationale: Persistent but hydrated diarrhea, needs review

test_cases.input: He's had pain on his lower right belly for a few hours, getting worse, and now has a bit of a fever.
test_cases.rationale: RLQ pain + fever = possible appendicitis

test_cases.input: My son suddenly has severe pain in one testicle, it came on very fast about an hour ago, he's in a lot of distress.
test_cases.rationale: Acute severe testicular pain = torsion, time-critical surgical emergency

test_cases.input: My teenager told me she doesn't want to be alive anymore and I found cuts on her arm from a razor.
test_cases.rationale: Suicidal ideation + self-harm = urgent mental health emergency

test_cases.input: He has hives all over his body after eating strawberries, but he's breathing fine and acting normal.
test_cases.rationale: Urticaria without systemic/respiratory involvement

test_cases.input: She fell off the playground slide, about 2 meters, cried right away, moving all limbs fine, no loss of consciousness.
test_cases.rationale: Fall from height but currently no red flags, needs observation

test_cases.input: Our dog bit him on the leg, there's a puncture wound bleeding a bit but I've stopped it with pressure.
test_cases.rationale: Animal bite, controlled bleeding, needs wound care/antibiotics

test_cases.input: She's had a few nosebleeds this week, each stops after a few minutes of pressure, otherwise fine.
test_cases.rationale: Recurrent self-resolving epistaxis

test_cases.input: He put a small bead up his nose, I can see it but can't get it out, he's breathing fine and not in pain.
test_cases.rationale: Visible nasal foreign body, no airway compromise

test_cases.input: My baby has been crying non-stop for 3 hours, nothing calms her, this isn't normal for her.
test_cases.rationale: Prolonged inconsolable crying in infant needs assessment

test_cases.input: My newborn's skin looks a bit yellow, especially her face, but she's feeding well and having wet diapers.
test_cases.rationale: Mild jaundice, feeding well, needs review not emergency

test_cases.input: The area around my baby's belly button looks red with some discharge, no fever though.
test_cases.rationale: Possible omphalitis, infection risk in neonate

test_cases.input: He got his vaccine yesterday and has a mild fever and a sore arm, otherwise acting normal.
test_cases.rationale: Expected post-vaccination reaction

test_cases.input: She wakes at night saying her legs hurt, but during the day she runs around fine, no swelling or fever.
test_cases.rationale: Typical growing pains

test_cases.input: He's been waking a lot at night this past week, no other symptoms, seems like a sleep phase.
test_cases.rationale: Behavioral, no medical red flags

test_cases.input: She's a really picky eater lately, only wants a few foods, but she's growing fine and has energy.
test_cases.rationale: Normal toddler picky eating

test_cases.input: Baby feels a little warm, about 37.8, drooling a lot too, still smiling and playing.
test_cases.rationale: Low-grade temp, likely teething, well child

test_cases.input: He has small blisters in his mouth and on his hands and feet, mild fever, still drinking fluids okay.
test_cases.rationale: Hand-foot-mouth disease, hydrated

test_cases.input: She has itchy spots all over her body that look like chickenpox, mild fever, otherwise mostly normal.
test_cases.rationale: Typical varicella, uncomplicated

test_cases.input: He has a high fever, red watery eyes, a bad cough, and now a rash starting on his face and spreading down.
test_cases.rationale: High fever + coryza + descending rash = possible measles, needs urgent review

test_cases.input: She has the worst headache she's ever had, says the light hurts her eyes, and her neck feels stiff.
test_cases.rationale: Severe headache + photophobia + neck stiffness = meningitis

test_cases.input: He suddenly won't put any weight on his leg, it's warm to touch, and he has a fever too.
test_cases.rationale: Refusal to bear weight + warm joint + fever = possible septic arthritis

test_cases.input: She swallowed a small coin about an hour ago, breathing normally, talking, not in any distress.
test_cases.rationale: Asymptomatic coin ingestion, needs review/imaging

test_cases.input: He spilled some hot tea on his hand, there's a small red mark, no blistering, he cried but calmed quickly.
test_cases.rationale: Minor superficial burn, no blistering

test_cases.input: A bee stung her arm, there's swelling at the sting site, but she's breathing fine and acting normal.
test_cases.rationale: Localized sting reaction, no systemic symptoms

test_cases.input: My baby has had a temperature of 39.5 since this morning and cries a lot when I change her nappy like it hurts to pee.
test_cases.rationale: High fever + dysuria signs in young infant = possible UTI/sepsis risk
